query:
SELECT id, sequenceKey, touchKey, version,
  CASE WHEN bodyText LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' THEN 'bodyText' ELSE '' END AS in_text,
  CASE WHEN bodyHtml LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' THEN 'bodyHtml' ELSE '' END AS in_html
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE bodyText LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' OR bodyHtml LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%'
ORDER BY sequenceKey, touchKey;
